title: Black Benny overrated; other bass drummers and a demonstration
summary: He ranks bass drummers: Sonny Allen, Jean Vigne and others against Black Benny, and taps out a street bass drum beat.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
